items.title: Mayday At 33,000 Feet: Leaky Faucet Floods Frontier Airlines Airbus A321neo Cabin
items.summary: In early-mid-November, a Frontier Airlines Airbus A321neo flying from Denver International to Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County had to divert to Chicago O'Hare after a leaky faucet flooded the floor of the passenger cabin. The pilots declared 'mayday' to air traffic control while cruising at 33,000 feet over eastern Iowa, and subsequently landed safely at Chicago O'Hare.
